verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports auto-approve/headless CLI mode for unattended runs (openhands-docs-3, openhands-docs-16), plus documented automations that trigger on schedules/webhooks (GitHub, Slack, Linear) and an API for scripting (openhands-docs-4, openhands-docs-13, openhands-docs-18, openhands-gh-4/5), which together enable CI-style automation. Missing for 10: a dedicated headless/CI-specific docs page or example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) and independent hands-on confirmation of unattended CI runs.
